correctness.rationale: The Green operator splits into integrals with invariant P and Q, and only P f and Q f enter their corresponding branches. Their sup-norm Lipschitz constants are D epsilon_s/delta_s and D epsilon_u/delta_u, yielding q. Applying stable/unstable strong dichotomy exponentials to Hölder differences independently gives precisely the displayed K_alpha, and an invariant Hölder ball radius K_alpha/(1-K_alpha). For the inverse, the two projected inequalities add to a full epsilon_s+epsilon_u perturbation bound, producing the 2D^2 sum correction to nonlinear growth by Gronwall, while final Green integrals retain separate coefficients. The symmetric algebra reduces to K_alpha=2 epsilon_s/(lambda(1-alpha^2)), and hence factor 2(1+alpha) against lambda(1-alpha)/4. Missing proof detail in original arXiv paper is an explicit verification limitation; conclusions are scoped to the standard classical hypotheses.
